cells.D6:
Intrinsic Arc Subclass Buff
Obtained by reaching 100% Counter Progress through Arc Kills within 6 seconds of each, or through Aspects.
Rank-And-File = 25% | Elite = 50% | Miniboss+ = 100% | Guardians = 50%

Amplified:
+50 Mobility, increases Slide Distance to 8.5 meters, +40 Handling, and 0.95x Handling Duration Multiplier for 15 seconds. 
Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer and grants 15% Damage Resist against Combatants while active.
While Amplified, sprinting for 2.5 seconds grants Speed Booster.

Speed Booster:
Maximizes Movement Speed, increased Slide Distance to 11 meters, 25% Increased Jump Height, and 15% Damage Resist against Combatants.
Speed Booster lingers for 2 seconds until no longer sprinting, even after Amplified runs out.
Performing a Speed Booster Slide permanently increases base Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters until death.

sources.supports: Amplified now has 15% PvE combatant damage resistance and reduces combatant accuracy.
Speed Booster starts after 2.5 seconds, lingers for 2 seconds, and may begin when already sprinting before Amplified.
Published patch notes independently list 2 second Speed Booster linger after stopping sprint.

implementation.kill_counter: One explicitly bound Arc intrinsic source per holder; 4 quarter-progress stacks, resetting 6 second window. Guardian/elite=2, miniboss/champion/boss=4, observed ordinary=1. Source tag classification remains host policy. Four quarters consume the counter and apply Amplified.
implementation.movement: 50 ms native-flag samples; first sample on application, no continuity inferred across unavailable/unknown state. A 2.5 second windup verifies current sprint again at expiry. Speed Booster has its own timer and refreshes to at least 2 seconds while observed sprinting after Amplified expires.
implementation.native_projection: Optional explicit calibration source supplies three delta parameters. Speed Booster replaces Amplified speed contribution; native jump_strength is not equated to 25% jump height.
implementation.damage_resistance: Separate 15% resistance contributions, requires explicit combatant source tag and excludes guardians; PvP mode yields zero. Missing native classification does not automatically receive PvE resistance.
implementation.lifetime: Reapplication keeps max remaining duration; Arc kills build a new counter after activation. Exact refresh, overflow and polling boundaries are content policies pending original-game calibration.

limits: No automatic production subclass assembly, aspect producers or unique-source enforcement yet.
Mobility and handling points / animation modifiers have query evidence; actual D2 movement curves, sprint cap, slide distances, permanent slide enhancement and combatant accuracy are not implemented.
Native speed/jump deltas in acceptance tests are synthetic required calibration values, not D2 physical conversion.
Sampling can miss sprint stops shorter than one server tick; no keyboard input, continuous movement prediction or teleport detection is claimed.
No persistence, HUD or production animation wiring.
